With nearly 50 years in the industry, we are Australia’s most trusted tinting network for car, home and office window tinting.

Here is what makes us the best window tinting Brisbane based service and the films we offer for home window tinting Brisbane

Why Choose Us For House Window Tinting In Brisbane?

In addition to offering a lifetime warranty on our home window tinting in Brisbane, here are more reasons why ours is the best window tinting Brisbane based service and why so many Australians trust us when it comes to their home window tinting:

  • We offer a lifetime warranty on all residential applications
  • We do a FREE measure & quote so you know exactly what you’re getting and how much it will be (no nasty surprises)
  • All installations are done by professionally trained installers
  • Our films (exclusive to us) are Government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality
  • We are Members of the Window Film Association of Australia so you know we’re accountable
  • We offer ‘no interest ever’ finance options through Zip Pay and Afterpay

Films Options For Home Tinting In Brisbane

We offer the following films through our home window tinting Brisbane based service:

  • Solar window films – reduces heat and glare from entering your home
  • Privacy films – offers privacy during the day without hindering the amount of natural light coming in
  • Safety films – makes your home safer (helps to prevent breakages and break-ins)
  • Security films – helps to prevent break-ins (7 x stronger than standard film)
  • Decorative films – offers privacy for areas like bathrooms

Book a Free Measure & Quote For House Window Tinting In Brisbane

Call 13TINT or use our Store Finder to locate your nearest store to arrange a FREE measure & quote with your local tinting technician.
